stem:
Anya has drawn base AB of length 5 cm. She must build triangle ABC with AC = 5 cm and BC = 5 cm.

Where should she place point C?

options.text: Anywhere on a compass arc drawn from A alone, ignoring B.
At any point that is 5 cm from A, even if its distance from B is different.
At a meeting point of the arc centred at A with radius 5 cm and the arc centred at B with radius 5 cm.
At the printed midpoint mark on segment AB, because that mark is darkest.

teacher.key_rationale: C must be 5 cm from A and 5 cm from B, so it lies at an intersection of the two equal-radius arcs. An arc from A alone is not enough. Dropping the distance to B omits a side condition. A mark on AB is not the third vertex.
